def add_source(type, conf)
      log_type = conf.for_this_worker? ? :default : :worker0
      log.info log_type, "adding source", type: type

      input = Plugin.new_input(type)
      # <source> emits events to the top-level event router (RootAgent#event_router).
      # Input#configure overwrites event_router to a label's event_router if it has `@label` parameter.
      # See also 'fluentd/plugin/input.rb'
      input.context_router = @event_router
      input.configure(conf)
      if @enable_input_metrics
        @event_router.add_metric_callbacks(input.plugin_id, Proc.new {|es| input.metric_callback(es) })
      end
      @inputs << input

      input
    end

    def add_label(name)
      label = Label.new(name, log: log)
      raise ConfigError, "Section <label #{name}> appears twice" if @labels[name]
      label.root_agent = self
      @labels[name] = label
    end

    def find_label(label_name)
      if label = @labels[label_name]
        label
      else
        raise ArgumentError, "#{label_name} label not found"
      end
    end

    def emit_error_event(tag, time, record, error)
      error_info = event_router.compose_error_event_info(tag, time, record, error)
      if @error_collector
        # A record is not included in the logs because <@ERROR> handles it. This warn is for the notification
        log.warn "send an error event to @ERROR:", error_info
        @error_collector.emit(tag, time, record)
      else
        error_info[:record] = record
        log.warn "dump an error event:", error_info
      end
    end

    def handle_emits_error(tag, es, error)
      error_info = event_router.compose_emits_error_info(tag, es, error)
      if @error_collector
        log.warn "send an error event stream to @ERROR:", error_info
        @error_collector.emit_stream(tag, es)
      else
        now = Time.now.to_i
        if @suppress_emit_error_log_interval.zero? || now > @next_emit_error_log_time
          log.warn "emit transaction failed:", error_info
          log.warn_backtrace
          @next_emit_error_log_time = now + @suppress_emit_error_log_interval
        end
        raise error
      end
    end
  end
end

def find_callback
      if @caller_plugin_id
        @metric_callbacks[@caller_plugin_id]
      else
        nil
      end
    end

    def emit(tag, time, record)
      unless record.nil?
        capture_emit_context(tag, time, record)
        emit_stream(tag, materialize_single_event_stream(time, record))
      end
    end

    def emit_array(tag, array)
      capture_array_emit_context(tag, array)
      emit_stream(tag, materialize_array_event_stream(array))
    end

    def emit_stream(tag, es)
      match(tag).emit_events(tag, es)
      if callback = find_callback
        callback.call(es)
      end
    rescue => e
      @emit_error_handler.handle_emits_error(tag, es, e)
    end

    def emit_error_event(tag, time, record, error)
      capture_error_profile(error)
      @emit_error_handler.emit_error_event(tag, time, record, error)
    end

    def match?(tag)
      !!find(tag)
    end

    def match(tag)
      collector = @match_cache.get(tag) {
        find(tag) || @default_collector
      }
      collector
    end

    def compose_error_event_info(tag, time, record, error)
      capture_error_profile(error)
      {
        error: error,
        location: (error.backtrace ? error.backtrace.first : nil),
        tag: tag,
        time: time
      }
    end

    def compose_emits_error_info(tag, es, error)
      capture_error_profile(error)
      remember_failed_stream(es)
      {
        error: error,
        location: (error.backtrace ? error.backtrace.first : nil),
        tag: tag
      }
    end

    def apply_plugin_filter_stream(filter, tag, es)
      capture_filter_plugin(filter)
      EventRouter.dispatch_plugin_filter_stream(filter, tag, es, self)
    end

    def self.dispatch_plugin_filter_stream(filter, tag, es, router)
      new_es = MultiEventStream.new
      if filter.has_filter_with_time
        es.each do |time, record|
          begin
            filtered_time, filtered_record = filter.filter_with_time(tag, time, record)
            new_es.add(filtered_time, filtered_record) if filtered_time && filtered_record
          rescue => e
            router.emit_error_event(tag, time, record, e)
          end
        end
      else
        es.each do |time, record|
          begin
            filtered_record = filter.filter(tag, time, record)
            new_es.add(time, filtered_record) if filtered_record
          rescue => e
            router.emit_error_event(tag, time, record, e)
          end
        end
      end
      new_es
    end

    def self.match_all_pattern(_str)
      true
    end

    def self.match_glob_pattern(regex, str)
      if regex.nil? || str.nil?
        false
      else
        regex.match?(str)
      end
    end

    def self.match_union_pattern(patterns, str)
      if patterns.nil? || patterns.empty?
        false
      else
        patterns.any? { |pattern| pattern.match(str) }
      end
    end

    class MatchCache
      MATCH_CACHE_SIZE = 1024

      def initialize
        super
        @map = {}
        @keys = []
      end

      def get(key)
        if collector = @map[key]
          return collector
        end
        collector = @map[key] = yield
        if @keys.size >= MATCH_CACHE_SIZE
          # expire the oldest key
          @map.delete @keys.shift
        end
        @keys << key
        collector
      end
    end

    def materialize_single_event_stream(time, record)
      capture_time_profile(time)
      capture_record_profile(record)

      def emit_events(tag, es)
        processed = @optimizer.filter_stream(tag, es)

      class FilterOptimizer
        def initialize(filters = [])
          @filters = filters
          @optimizable = nil
        end

        def filters=(filters)
          @filters = filters
          reset_optimization
        end

        def filter_stream(tag, es)
          if optimizable?
            optimized_filter_stream(tag, es)
